_about: Professors are helpers: they give the quest, give tips, and can be called once per stage for an assist. They can never be damaged. displayName is what the game shows; real names must never appear anywhere in the game, the code, or the repository's public text.

assist.name: Time dilation
assist.effect: Freezes the Deadline wall for 8 seconds

professors.spriteNote: Original character design. Do NOT base the sprite on the film character of the same name.

professors.personalityRuleDetail: If the player fails any stage of his course, there is no retake: he passes them with a fixed score of 70 (a C) and the game moves on.

assist.name: Stress detected
assist.effect: Restores 40 Sanity. Reference: his research is on computer models of emotion and stress detection.

achievement.name: Curved
achievement.condition: Pass his whole course without winning a single stage

professors.speechStyle: Few words. Speech bubbles are often a formula written on a small whiteboard instead of a sentence. Warm asides in Uzbek. Never written with misspellings or imitated pronunciation.

assist.name: Isometry
assist.effect: For 5 seconds every paper keeps its current distance from the player: none can come closer. Reference: his research is on isometries of Banach spaces.

achievement.name: Q.E.D.
achievement.condition: Finish his final with full Sanity
